container: /entries; ordinal is zero-based list position, from original custody _reference_metadata
file_invocation: Small standalone fixed-input entry point; verify reviewed self/frame/source pins before source access, reserve exclusive output directory first, one bounded read per object, fixed slots, first closed failure retained. No network/upstream loader/alternate path/fallback.
fixture_api: Generated bytes only; rejects either known actual object identity before JSON parsing. File wrapper tests only generated temporary files with fixture-only specs.

parser_bounds.source_byte_caps: Each exact expected object length plus one byte; no automatic widening.

parser_design: One strict recursive JSON parse, bounded before descent/node allocation; duplicate keys, nonstandard constants, invalid UTF-8 and ambiguous field types rejected. Numeric lexemes are parsed for JSON syntax then discarded into opaque markers, with whole-source/JSON/value-token machine exposure explicit; no numeric completeness/finiteness/scientific checks.
private_output: Atomic complete 43-location documentary projection only after both source objects and every selected context pass; on failure private projection null, public partial exposure retained.
public_output: Closed counts/presence/status/progress plus original pinned candidate graph only; no new arbitrary source strings, values or per-field hashes. Bibliography/public paraphrases require a separate human publication review of private documentary projection.
scientific_limits: No raw run/bound evidence objects read
Historical figure map is not the re-relaxed calculator
Selected citation/URL/notes may expose numeric outcomes, conditions and conclusions; not target-free
source_field_schema: Pinned binding.py TargetSource/TargetEntry/TargetFile; no upstream import or execution. Source extras and other entry fields are not projected; notes may declare conditions or rights, otherwise UNKNOWN.
